books.title: Books
books.intro: Books read aloud from e-book catalogs (OPDS), such as Standard Ebooks or your own library server. Add the catalogs here; the books in them can then be asked for by title or author.
books.catalogs.title: Catalogs
books.ask: Say "read me the book …" or "read my books" to hear one.
books.f.name: Name
books.f.username: User name (if it needs a login)
books.none: No catalogs. Add one to have books to read.
books.add.hint: An address that is already there is changed. Leave the password empty to keep the one it has.
books.err.url: A catalog's address starts with http:// or https://.
books.err.bar: A catalog's fields cannot contain | or a line break.
books.err.hours: Give the hours as a number.
